about_the_game:
Nounishpunk is a fast-paced third-person action-adventure game with open-world exploration and skateboarding. Inspired by Sunset Overdrive, Ratchet & Clank, and Batman.

Traverse a vibrant futuristic city, fight enemies with ridiculous weapons, and master high-speed movement. No filler, no hand-holding—just pure gameplay. Despite its colorful art style, it’s designed for players who love skill-based action.

Demo Playtime: 1-4h. Try the demo now and help us shape the final game with your feedback!

Features:

  • Open-World Exploration: Roam freely in a lively cyberpunk city filled with missions and challenges.

  • Motorized Skateboarding: Experience high-speed movement and fluid traversal across the environment.

  • Unique & Ridiculous Weapons: Engage in fast-paced combat with a variety of over-the-top weaponry.

  • Captivating Futuristic Art Style: A visually stunning world with a unique sci-fi aesthetic.


Play the Demo & Give Feedback!

We’re actively developing Nounishpunk, and your feedback is invaluable. Try the demo, share your thoughts, and help us make the game even better!

Note: This game is still in development, and features may change before release.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790 or AMD Ryzen 5 5500
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 or RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i9 11900 or Ryzen 9 5900X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3080 or AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
